act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and to provide for general rules and principles of evidence for fair trial.

section.heading: Production of documents or electronic records which another person, having possession, could refuse to produce
section.html: No one shall be compelled to produce documents in his possession or electronic records under his control, which any other person would be entitled to refuse to produce if they were in his possession or control, unless such last-mentioned person consents to their production.
section.text: No one shall be compelled to produce documents in his possession or electronic records under his control, which any other person would be entitled to refuse to produce if they were in his possession or control, unless such last-mentioned person consents to their production.
